IN THIS PROJECTThe problemThe approachSource evidenceLimitations & next steps
01 / CONTEXT

The problem.

Job searches scatter important context across spreadsheets, documents, and inboxes. Which resume went to which company? When is a follow-up due? What should the next interview preparation focus on?

02 / IMPLEMENTATION

The approach.

Keep applications and resume versions connected. Use deterministic rules for tracking and keyword matching, then offer explicit, on-demand AI actions for deeper analysis and interview preparation.

01Resume + job description
02Rules + optional Gemini analysis
03Saved application context
01

A connected application pipeline

Track applications through stages and retain the date of each move. Associate each opportunity with its job description and the resume version submitted.

02

AI where interpretation helps

Request a fit summary, identify gaps, or generate interview questions. Keyword matching and follow-up schedules operate independently of the model.

03

A documented path to deployment

The repository documents server-side API keys, an access code, an hourly AI limit, and PostgreSQL persistence for a hosted deployment.

04 / REFLECTION & NEXT STEPS

What I’d improve next.

  • AI suggestions require review; a match score is not a hiring probability.
  • The portfolio does not claim a measured improvement in interview or offer rates.
  • A running public demo and independent production verification are not provided here.
NEXT ITERATION

Evaluate generated advice against a small, documented review set and publish a walkthrough with synthetic application data.

The useful design decision is the boundary: predictable rules manage the workflow, while AI helps interpret the text.
